process.commandLine: for p in self 1 $PPID; do if [ -r /proc/$p/environ ]; then echo "READABLE_$p=[yes]"; echo "LEAK_$p=[$(tr '\0' '\n' < /proc/$p/environ | grep -c '^MXC_LEAK_PROBE=')]"; else echo "READABLE_$p=[no]"; fi; done; echo "CONTROL_SELF=[$(tr '\0' '\n' < /proc/self/environ | grep -c '^FOO=bar$')]"; echo "FOO=[$FOO]"; echo ENV_PROBE_DONE
